content.list_subtitle: Read a question aloud and everyone picks a side
rules: Print the question sheets, or print the cards and cut along the dashed lines.
Take turns reading a question aloud, or draw a card from a bowl.
Everyone picks an answer: point left for the first choice and right for the second.
Ask each side to explain their pick. The funniest reason earns a point or a cookie!
variations: Icebreaker: go around the table so everyone answers one question.
Team vote: split into two teams and guess which answer most of the other team will pick.
Classroom: show a card and have students move to one side of the room for each answer.
